comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: Correcting the Day 7 number openly is a good habit. The line that stands out to me is 20% on the real account against 600% on paper, because that gap is the real result: if you line up each real trade with the paper trade from the same minute and average the difference in fill price, you'll see how much of the paper profit is fills that don't exist live, especially on sudden moves like today. On the auto-fix checks, keeping recovery inside a fixed session window is sensible, and I'd also make sure the repair step can only restart or reconnect things and never place or close an order on its own beyond the limits you set. Cymetica's Bring Your Own Agent page is one place to see how agents get connected to markets with limits set outside the model.
